description.value: Caravanserai Uyghur Cuisine brings the bold flavors of the Central Asian Silk Road to Vancouver's SE Marine Drive, specializing in hand-stretched Laghman noodles, slow-simmered lamb Polo rice pilaf, and hearth-baked Nang bread using 100% Halal-certified ingredients. The menu spans signature dishes like the showstopping Dapanji big-plate chicken to lighter cold noodle dishes, making it one of Metro Vancouver's rare dedicated Uyghur restaurants. It is a distinctive cultural dining destination for cyclists exploring the southern reaches of the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms an active Uyghur restaurant at 1652 SE Marine Drive, Vancouver, with a full current menu and online ordering. The OSM phone number (+1-604-336-0570) differs from the phone shown consistently on the website (1-778-986-8678), so the website value is used as primary. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill was found anywhere in the website content.
